column1: # Headlines chosen by hand for HSK 1 to 5, where the dictionary's first sense is not what
# a learner means by the word. CC-CEDICT orders senses roughly by history, not use, so 在
# heads with "to exist" and 穿 with "to bore through"; Wiktionary was checked and orders
# Hanzi, then a reading when HSK's is not the everyday one (blank to keep it), then the
# headline, tab separated. A headline that is one of the reading's senses is moved to the
# front; one that is not is put first, with the dictionary's senses after it. A fourth
# column, where given, is every other meaning, " | " between them, in place of the
# dictionary's. Written in the dictionary's style, asides and all, since a tile shows it
# HSK 1 to 3 were reviewed by a native speaker on 2026-09-28. Where she found two meanings
# equally common (离) the headline carries both; for 不好意思, 才 and 记 she chose the drafts
# on a second pass. HSK 4 was reviewed the same way, the same day, and HSK 5 on 2026-09-29.
